name: Controlled SWAP (H-box)
summary: The controlled SWAP is a Toffoli gate sandwiched between two CNOTs.
description: The Fredkin gate swaps qubits 2 and 3 when qubit 1 is $|1\rangle$. It equals $\mathrm{CNOT}_{3\to2}\,\mathrm{Toffoli}_{1,2\to3}\,\mathrm{CNOT}_{3\to2}$; here the Toffoli is drawn with an H-box and the CNOTs as Z- and X-spiders.
